ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 10-15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark grey (#1C1C1C) pigmentation. Small, high-contrast light grey (#D3D3D3) mottling and speckling are clustered in the medial regions of both lobes, with higher density near the base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at approximately 55 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and nicks are most prominent on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex trajectory tapering into a linear, slightly concave sweep as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small white circular spots (rosette-like patterns) visible on the inner-basal portion of the right lobe and scattered on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular nicks and notches along the trailing edge boundary, specifically a deeper indentation near the tip of the right lobe; white scar-like mottling on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Digital camera viewfinder UI elements present, including a white focus/crop rectangle and magnification/tool icons in the bottom right corner.
